name: sentry
description: Audit, initialize and harden Sentry in any repo, CLI-first on the sentry v4 CLI. Detects what the repo is, finds gaps or sets Sentry up properly, applies only what you approve, and proves it with a live event.

interface.shortDescription: Audit or set up Sentry in any repo, proven with a live event
interface.longDescription: Detects what the repo is, audits or initializes Sentry (errors, tracing, profiling, replay, logs, crons, releases, source maps, privacy), applies only the changes you approve, and proves each one with a live event. CLI-first on the sentry v4 CLI. In Codex the work runs inline in one thread and questions are asked as numbered lists.
